text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, where the computer not only recognises objects but also finds their position in the image. Computer vision has many useful applications in everyday life, from medical imaging to security systems. One of the most exciting examples is self-driving cars. These vehicles use cameras and computer vision to detect other cars, pedestrians, and road signs, helping them drive safely.
